title: L4/L5 Workflow Hardening
summary: Stress-test L4 Brainstorm and L5 Coordinator under multi-round, concurrent, and interrupt scenarios. Fix discovered reliability issues. Wire VectorSearch DI deferred from Phase 1 and verify Phase 1 → Phase 2 integration end-to-end.
approach: 4 waves: Audit + harness (parallel) → L4 + L5 stress execution (parallel) → fix + document (sequential) → DI wire + integration + regression (sequential). Tests use mocked agents but real SessionManager/IterativeRetriever paths to catch state-machine and persistence bugs without flaky LLM calls. L4 5-round semantics = 5 sequential re-invocations of execute() with accumulating state.context.

data_flow.diagram: TASK-001 (audit doc) → TASK-002 (harness) → [TASK-003 L4 results, TASK-004 L5 results] → TASK-005 (fixes) → TASK-006 (issues.jsonl) → TASK-007 (DI + integration test) → TASK-008 (full regression)
stages: Audit produces state-machine map + known failure modes → harness builds fixtures
Stress runs produce results.json with failures listed → fixes target failures
Fixes harvested → remaining gaps documented as issues
DI wiring enables real semantic search → regression validates no Phase 1 break

design_decisions: L4 5-round = 5 sequential execute() calls accumulating state.context (no class refactor)
Test fidelity = mocked agents + real SessionManager + real IterativeRetriever (catches state/persistence bugs without LLM flakiness)
Phase 1 deferred DI wiring (VectorSearch → GraphManager) folds into TASK-007 with integration verification
Concurrent session test exercises shared graph state via two L4 sessions hitting same .writing/sessions root

patterns: Sidecar test pattern: vitest .test.js next to source (e.g. search/hybrid-search.test.js)
SessionManager test boundary: use tmp dir per test, cleanup in afterEach
Mock agent pattern: stub container.getAgent() to return deterministic .generate() responses
conventions: Async tests: use `await` not `.then()`, assert via vitest expect
Concurrent test: use Promise.all + separate session IDs, NOT shared state
dependencies: Vitest configs: vitest.config.js (default), vitest.phase2.config.js, vitest.phase3.config.js, vitest.phase4.config.js
Phase 1 outputs: graph-manager.js setVectorSearch DI, search/index.js createIterativeRetriever
node:fs, node:path, node:crypto for harness fixtures
